{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjdzc8AAAABbtkpBQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IVzhFRH6g", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IV", "number": 93, "title": "Correct concurrent CD sector streaming and SCU DMA scheduling during guest execution", "body": "## Problem

The emulator now boots original Saturn-IP/ISO9660 applications through a **guest-executed synthetic ExternalBios** (#83/#84, #85/#86), and #91/#92 verified runtime directory/file access and fixed the interrupted GET DataEnd accounting. Yet the original runtime reader in [`docs/cd-runtime.md`](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/docs/cd-runtime.md) uses a **synchronous, single-threaded request/transfer sequence**. Its successful file reads do not demonstrate faithful **overlap between CD sector acquisition, available host/selector operations, SCU DMA, running SH-2s and video/sound hardware**, especially when the CD sector pool fills, an in-flight transfer is interrupted, or consumers are slower than the drive.

The repository already has scheduled sector acquisition, sector partitions/selectors, a 200-sector pool, CD HIRQ/SCU interrupts, DMA and partial-overlap tests. **Do not reimplement working behavior or assume arbitrary CD commands may overlap**. The remaining [hardware conformance matrix](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/docs/hardware-conformance.md) explicitly leaves complete transfer overlap, full-buffer resume, command-specific timing, cross-device contention and cancellation contracts pending.

A next **hardware-focused**, bounded step toward game compatibility is to find and correct a **primary-manual-supported scheduling/ownership failure under actual streaming overlap**, while demonstrating an original guest continuing real computation and rendering/audio work during CD I/O.

This does not establish genuine Sega BIOS, Sega SDK CDC/GFS binary compatibility, retail game loading or full Saturn conformance.

## Expected outcome

A new **original MIT-licensed SH-2 guest integration scenario**, loaded by the existing firmware-driven ExternalBios path, streams authored data from a mounted multi-sector ISO or BIN/CUE using real CD MMIO, selector/partition/host-transfer commands and SCU DMA **while the master SH-2 continues executing guest instructions and real VDP2 and/or sound hardware advances**. If a sound path is used, it must be generated by executed guest/MC68EC000/SCSP behavior rather than JavaScript-generated samples.

The emulator must correctly schedule hardware operations that are allowed to overlap, while retaining all documented mutual exclusions, waits, FIFOs, buffer identities, HIRQ/SCU acknowledgments, partial-transfer counts, CPU/DMA ordering, and abort/reset semantics. Existing fixed latency conventions should be labeled; do not misrepresent them as physically measured controller timing.

**Scope deliberately stays within a finite, testable hardware interaction**: one bounded stream/consumer scenario, small enough to validate independently, that reveals at least one actual production hardware defect. Full asynchronous GFS callbacks, arbitrary parallel application API calls, complete physical-drive timing and universal SCU/VDP/SCSP bus arbitration are not required.

## Context and reproduction

At Issue creation, `main` = `bf76a3ffe26872a72157e9ddfaf6c84be045faf6`; no open Issues or PRs. Inspect code and actual contracts before implementing:

- [`docs/cd-runtime.md`](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/docs/cd-runtime.md), [`docs/validation-issue-91.md`](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/docs/validation-issue-91.md), `tests/cd_runtime.rs`, `tests/fixtures/cd-runtime.s`, `scripts/cd-runtime.mjs`: established runtime reader, real CD commands and DataEnd correction; **preserve** full byte, cursor, IRQ, DMA and screen oracles.
- [`docs/hardware-conformance.md`](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/docs/hardware-conformance.md) (CD command/status, selector/partition, scheduled directory, SCU DMA and multiprocessor sections), `src/cd.rs`, `src/cd_rw.rs`, `src/scu.rs`, `src/bus.rs`, `src/lib.rs`, `src/vdp2.rs`, `src/sound.rs`, `src/timing.rs`, and pertinent `tests/cd*.rs`, `tests/dma_startup.rs`, `tests/scu*.rs`.
- [`docs/external-startup.md`](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/docs/external-startup.md) and [`docs/architecture.md`](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): ExternalBios mode must not install HLE services or host-load executable/data bytes.
- [`docs/ci-performance.md`](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/docs/ci-performance.md): use light, independent unit/device oracles and a focused number of guest/browser scenarios to avoid unnecessary suite cost.
- Primary documents: [CD Communication I/F ST-162-062094](https://github.com/luckyseoul/saturn-docs/blob/main/files/ST-162-062094.pdf) §§3–5 and 8.2 (drive/sector/selector/host transaction classes and HIRQ); [SCU ST-097-R5-072694](https://github.com/luckyseoul/saturn-docs/blob/main/files/ST-097-R5-072694.pdf) DMA/interrupt/bus sections and [ST-210 final corrections](https://github.com/luckyseoul/saturn-docs/blob/main/files/ST-210-110194.pdf); applicable SH7604, VDP2 and SCSP manuals linked from the conformance matrix. Verify exact pages/revisions and reconcile conflicting documents before asserting a hardware rule.

**Establish an inherited-main negative control first.** Build an original guest and two independently generated source media variants that schedule drive/play acquisition while a guest consumes previous sectors with FIFO/SCU DMA and processes/display-updates already transferred bytes. Include a bounded, genuinely slow-consumer or full-pool case if permitted by the documented hardware. Trace each hardware engine's deadlines, pending flags, selector/partition and pool identity, FIFO transaction, DMA publication, CPU progress and output. Find a *specific* mismatch against the primary hardware contract on unchanged inherited main, show it failing, and fix its actual cause. If the chosen overlap already works, tighten the trace on a documented, demonstrable unresolved edge rather than inventing a fault, weakening the oracle or declaring success with tests alone.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] **Primary-grounded concurrency contract:** produce a concise stage/operation matrix distinguishing drive acquisition, selector/partition jobs, the host FIFO/GET/DELETE, SCU DMA, CPU instruction scheduling, HIRQ and any VDP2/SCSP observation. Identify permitted simultaneous activity versus mutually exclusive operations, cancellation points, accepted payload ownership and before/at/after deadlines, with exact manual citations. Label all remaining deterministic emulator conventions and unsupported electrical details.
- [ ] **Reproducible real baseline failure:** an unchanged original guest/media/test oracle must fail against the inherited `bf76a3f` implementation at a **specific hardware-visible defect** (data ownership, status/IRQ, transfer overlap, pool-full WAIT/resume, arbitration/deadline, etc.) while preserving previously supported CD commands. Record actual failing literal values and explain why it is an emulator defect rather than a guest/setup mistake.
- [ ] **Production hardware correction:** change the smallest appropriate existing CD/SCU/bus/device scheduler implementation. Ensure real sector acceptance, reserved sector identity, backpressure/resumption at the correct FAD, selector/partition buffering, host transfer, SCU DMA source/destination publication and HIRQ/SCU level/acknowledgment semantics. Hardware progression must be tied to reference/CPU clocks, not wall-clock timers, JavaScript callbacks or instantaneous host data transfers. Never add a ROM/ISO-signature special case, simulated success register or software-library interception.
- [ ] **Genuine guest overlap:** boot through the existing synthetic ExternalBios loader; execute a new original guest that repeatedly computes over prior CD chunks and **changes actual VDP2 guest-visible pixels** while one or more subsequent sectors are in flight; perform actual independent SCU DMA and appropriate interrupt handling, not merely a log labeled 'concurrent'. Ensure the master SH-2 makes provable instruction/FRT progress and reaches distinguishable milestones *before* the stream completes. Existing sound/MC68EC000/SCSP advances with reference time; where meaningful add an independently specified guest-driven sound output check without fabricating host audio.
- [ ] **Data, backpressure and ordering oracles:** test multi-sector (including non-sector-aligned final byte count where applicable) input and distinct changing source bytes, DMA length/address increments, real sector-buffer identities, FIFO consumption/GET/DataEnd, partial sector or transfer completion and preserved output canaries. Exercise fast and slow consumers, a bounded pool/partition-full condition with documented WAIT/recovery, and a competing hardware operation only if the manuals permit it. Compare exact records, complete fetched byte arrays and independently expected video output; modify disc bytes to prove no hidden static asset result.
- [ ] **Cancellation and reset correctness:** exercise an abort while drive/selector/transfer work is pending, bus/DMA contention or masked IRQ, end-of-range/EOF, no media, CD command rejection, rearm/restart and cold/SYSRES boundaries. No duplicate IRQ acknowledgment, stale FIFO exposure, lost/duplicated sector, premature DMA completion, partial ghost writes or bypass of preserved physical medium should occur. Preserve valid pending work only where specified.
- [ ] **Scheduling determinism:** assert literal clock/phase fences before/at/after critical events and compare advance chunks (e.g. 1/3/17/10000 when applicable) plus passive debugger inspection on/off. Hardware results and guest progress must not depend on the stepping granularity or observations; keep tests bounded and perform expensive cross-device permutations at the lightest appropriate layer.
- [ ] **Multiple licensed media and browser fidelity:** run the same original firmware/guest code against at least two synthesized original disc/data layouts; native Rust plus production Wasm/Chromium at `/saturn-rust/` must agree on real guest register/RAM and Canvas pixels and honor local media privacy. No proprietary BIOS, retail disc or SDK source/binary may be required or committed. Preserve BIOS-less HLE, Star Collector, Prism Courier, Hardware Lab and existing audio/graphics/input/backup tests.
- [ ] **Full existing CI coverage and performance discipline:** retain all existing **1,142 Rust tests, 72 browser groups, 101 fixture builders and 13 CI runner tests** (these are the checked baseline, not fixed future totals) with their independent assertions and exact tested-artifact digest/build barrier. Register new fixtures and focused tests without deleting coverage, blanket retries, disabling regressions, excessive timeout increases or unnecessary browser duplication; report any change in suite time.
- [ ] **Execute all applicable checks before merge:** `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo build --locked`, `cargo test --locked`, native all-target and Wasm `cargo clippy --locked ... -- -D warnings`, `sh scripts/check-fixtures.sh`, `sh scripts/build-web.sh`, `node --test scripts/ci-runner.test.mjs`, and complete `npm run test:browser`. Require successful applicable PR GitHub Actions jobs; record actual commands, counts, elapsed times, test failures fixed, inherited-main control, and fixture hashes. No mandatory physical-device testing, human sign-off, subjective evaluation or live Pages inspection.
- [ ] **Accurate handoff and documentation:** add a primary-derived focused stream/overlap contract and `docs/validation-issue-<actual-number>.md` with independently written oracles and reproduction steps. Update `docs/hardware-conformance.md`, `docs/architecture.md` and relevant CD/CI docs precisely for verified behavior and remaining gaps. Explicitly state that **full cross-chip arbitration, arbitrary asynchronous CDC/GFS calls, real Sega BIOS/SDK ABI and commercial games are not verified** by this bounded milestone.

## Optional validation

Additional original BIN/CUE, raw/XA or mixed-mode streaming, audio CD-DA overlap, more than one independent selector consumer, MC68EC000/SCSP sample-exact checks, alternate video modes and measured test-performance comparisons can be added when independently testable and not a barrier to completing the required focused scenario. Do not require an actual Saturn, commercial firmware/disc, manual approval, or expanded combinatorial testing without a distinct defect it catches.

## Required post-merge verification

None. All applicable functional and PR CI checks are pre-merge requirements. The existing main-only Pages deployment remains governed by the existing workflow; live deployment inspection is not a completion gate.

## Related work

Follow-up to [#91/#92](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/pull/92) (runtime reader and interrupted GET counts), [#85/#86](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/pull/86) (firmware file discovery), [#83/#84](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/pull/84) (ExternalBios hardware boot), and #17's still-incomplete technical hardware scope (the historical Issue #17 itself is **closed**, not an open tracker). This Issue is a **specific CD-streaming hardware conformance increment**, not a declaration of general Saturn emulation compatibility.
